content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To go to the springsteen show, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Enter the stadium gates (10 minutes)
Step 2. Research tour dates and venues (2 hours)
Step 3. Create a Ticketmaster account (10 minutes)
Step 4. Print out physical backup tickets (5 minutes)
Step 5. Buy a souvenir tour program (5 minutes)
Step 6. Set a calendar reminder for the pre-sale (2 minutes)
Step 7. Locate your specific section and row (10 minutes)
Step 8. Verify your email address for account security (2 minutes)
Step 9. Select the best available seats from the map (5 minutes)
Step 10. Enter credit card billing information (3 minutes)
Step 11. Join the virtual waiting room (15 minutes)
Step 12. Decide on a budget for the tickets (30 minutes)
Step 13. Confirm the purchase and receive a reference code (1 minute)
Step 14. Book a hotel room near the venue (20 minutes)
Step 15. Buy a commemorative concert t-shirt (10 minutes)
Step 16. Download the digital ticket app (5 minutes)
Step 17. Register for a "Verified Fan" access code (10 minutes)
Step 18. Check your bank balance for sufficient funds (2 minutes)
Step 19. Listen to the latest album to learn new lyrics (1 hour)
Step 20. Charge your phone to 100% for the digital entry (2 hours)
Step 21. Receive the text message with the unique access code (1 minute)
Step 22. Coordinate with friends on which night to attend (1 hour)
Step 23. Ask for the day off from work (1 day)
Step 24. Arrange a carpool with other fans (30 minutes)
Step 25. Pack a portable battery charger (5 minutes)
Step 26. Plan the outfit you will wear (20 minutes)
Step 27. Find your physical wallet (5 minutes)
Step 28. Check the venue's bag policy (10 minutes)
Step 29. Compare prices between different ticket tiers (45 minutes)
Step 30. Drive to the stadium parking lot (1 hour)
Step 31. Read online forums for ticket buying tips (1 hour)
Step 32. Find your assigned seat and sit down (5 minutes)
Step 33. Log into the app on your mobile device (2 minutes)
Step 34. Check the weather forecast for the show date (5 minutes)
Step 35. Decide on the preferred parking zone (15 minutes)
Step 36. Look up the stadium's prohibited items list (10 minutes)
Step 37. Withdraw some emergency cash (10 minutes)
Step 38. Pick a meeting spot in case the group gets separated (10 minutes)
Step 39. Install the latest OS update on your phone (20 minutes)
Step 40. Book an Uber or Lyft for the return trip (5 minutes)
Step 41. Request a digital receipt for the transaction (2 minutes)
Step 42. Wait for the countdown clock to hit zero (10 minutes)
Step 43. Receive the confirmation email (2 minutes)
Step 44. Watch the opening song of the set (6 minutes)
Step 45. Enter the CVV security code for the payment (30 seconds)
Step 46. Reserve a table for a pre-show dinner (15 minutes)
Step 47. Refresh the browser page (10 seconds)
Step 48. Check the traffic report on the day of the show (10 minutes)
Step 49. Add the tickets to your Apple/Google Wallet (2 minutes)
Step 50. Walk through the metal detectors (3 minutes)
Step 51. Read the "Know Before You Go" email (15 minutes)
Step 52. Select the "Electronic Delivery" option (1 minute)
Step 53. Print out the driving directions (5 minutes)
Step 54. Compare different parking garage rates (20 minutes)
Step 55. Wait for the lights to dim and the band to start (5 minutes)
Step 56. Buy a bottle of water before the show starts (5 minutes)
Step 57. Put on your comfortable walking shoes (2 minutes)
Step 58. Walk from the parking lot to the stadium entrance (15 minutes)
Step 59. Show your digital ticket to the usher (30 seconds)
Step 60. Set your phone to "Do Not Disturb" mode (1 minute)
Step 61. Open the digital ticket for scanning (30 seconds)
Step 62. Double-check that you have your ID (1 minute)
Step 63. Create a playlist of the likely setlist (30 minutes)
Step 64. Use the restroom before heading to your seat (10 minutes)
Step 65. Fuel up the car with gas (10 minutes)
Step 66. Enjoy the first encore (15 minutes)
Step 67. Save the digital ticket as a PDF (2 minutes)
Step 68. Discuss the logistics with your spouse (30 minutes)
Step 69. Lay out your clothes the night before (10 minutes)
Step 70. Sign up for the artist's newsletter (5 minutes)
Step 71. Update your primary email address (5 minutes)
Step 72. Check for any rescheduled date announcements (10 minutes)
Step 73. Scan the QR code at the turnstile (10 seconds)
Step 74. Mark the on-sale date in your physical planner (2 minutes)
Step 75. Clear your browser cookies and cache (5 minutes)
Step 76. Take a photo of the stage before the show (1 minute)
Step 77. Print a map of the stadium layout (5 minutes)
Step 78. Eat a light meal before leaving the house (30 minutes)
Step 79. Cheer as Bruce Springsteen takes the stage (1 minute)
Step 80. Submit the final payment form (1 minute)
Step 81. Check for any available promo codes (10 minutes)
Step 82. Set an alarm to wake up early on ticket day (1 minute)
Step 83. Confirm the guest list with your party (15 minutes)
Step 84. Read the ticket purchase terms and conditions (10 minutes)
Step 85. Check the gate number listed on your ticket (2 minutes)
Step 86. Grab your keys and wallet (1 minute)
Step 87. Charge your smartwatch (1 hour)
Step 88. Sing along to "Born to Run" (5 minutes)
Step 89. Buy a clear plastic bag that meets stadium rules (15 minutes)
Step 90. Get your ticket scanned by the gate attendant (15 seconds)
